Flow.description: RT – Case – Re-Route and Alert. After-save record-triggered flow on Case (update only). Entry criteria: Type field changed (compared to $Record__Prior.Type). Re-triggers assignment rules and sends a re-route notification. Also logs a success-path CaseComment documenting the re-route. Fault path logs a CaseComment. IPOP-6. Part-A item 2: success-path CaseComment added.

formulas.description: True when the case Type has changed since the last save.
formulas.name: forB_TypeChanged

formulas.description: Builds the re-route comment body documenting the type change.
formulas.name: forT_ReRouteComment
formulas.expression: "SYSTEM: Case type changed from '" & TEXT($Record__Prior.Type) & "' to '" & TEXT($Record.Type) & "' on " & TEXT(NOW()) & ". Case re-routed to the appropriate queue via assignment rules."

Flow.interviewLabel: Case After Update Re Route And Alert {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: RT – Case – Re-Route and Alert

recordCreates.description: Success path: logs a CaseComment documenting the type change and re-route. Part-A item 2 (IPOP-6).
recordCreates.name: Log_ReRoute_Success
recordCreates.label: Log Re-Route Success as Case Comment

actionCalls.description: Sends an email notification to the new queue informing them of the re-routed case.
actionCalls.name: Send_ReRoute_Notification
actionCalls.label: Send Re-Route Notification Email

recordCreates.description: Fault path: if any step fails, log a CaseComment so staff are aware of the failure.
recordCreates.name: Log_ReRoute_Fault
recordCreates.label: Log Re-Route Failure as Case Comment

value.stringValue: SYSTEM ALERT: Case re-route notification failed. Please check the case assignment manually. Flow fault: {!$Flow.FaultMessage}
